title: Answer: consciousness is a system’s experience of its own information

statements.text: Consciousness is the information system’s experience of its own information state and processing. In Faggin’s picture it is the capacity of a consciousness unit to perceive and know itself and the other units.

sources.quote: P1: psychoinformational principle: Consciousness is the information-system’s experience of its own information state and processing.

sources.locator: section 'The Properties of the Consciousness Units'
sources.quote: Consciousness is the capacity to perceive and know (comprehend) itself and the other CUs.
